notes.title: Update 1.0.8!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185707/43d053209ae63c723c190080279dab7fc94507be.jpg[/img]
1.0.8? and what about updates since 1.0.3? 
There have been small updates of the game to fix some bugs or to add some effects. I have not considered it necessary to make a post about each of them.

As a summary, this is what has changed from 1.0.3 to 1.0.8:
[list]
[*] Added feedback from enemies when you hit them.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused bonus missions, on max difficulty, to not be assigned correctly.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the fire of the rocks of the stone boss to make a strange trajectory when destroyed (it's only a visual error, it didn't affect the player at all).
[*] Fixed a problem that caused the player movement to be only in 8 directions (now the player has a better control over the submarine).
[*] Fixed other small bugs.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.3 - Minor changes and bug fixes
notes.content:
Greetings captains!

I have been working on more changes to keep improving the game:

[list]
[*] The amount of enemies on screen has been limited.
[*] Greatly reduced the requirements of enemies eliminated to unlock submarines.
[*] Fixed a bug that occurred when the trader appeared: If you played with the controller, a menu option was selected instead of the dialog.
[*] Other minor bugs fixed
[*] Applied changes from 1.0.2
[/list]

[i]I wanted to apologize, as I saw that the previous update had not been applied correctly. I have been very busy and for some strange reason Steam did not publish the changes. Now I have made sure that this update has been published correctly. [/i]

Thank you very much to everyone for the feedback!

notes.title: Minor game update to 1.0.2
notes.content:
[b]Enemy Health Adjustments:[/b]
[list]
[*] Jellyfish: Health reduced by 50%.
[*] Piranha: Health reduced by 50%.
[*] Pufferfish: Health reduced by 42%.
[*] Electric Eel: Health reduced by 33%.
[*] Angler Fish: Health reduced by 33%.
[*] Starfish: Health reduced by 38%.
[*] Seahorse: Health reduced by 40%.
[*] Sea Urchin: Health reduced by 43%.
[*] Bosses: Health reduced by 67%.
[/list]

[b]Damage Type Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Physical: Accumulated damage is now 18% (previously 15%).
[*] Heat: Increased damage is now 30% (previously 25%).
[*] Explosive: Stun duration is now 1s (previously 0.75s).
[*] Poison: Time before damage is now 4s (previously 5s).
[*] Electric: Slow duration is now 0.75s (previously 0.5s).
[*] Cold: No changes.
[/list]

[b]Changes to Collectible Item Duration:[/b]
[list]
[*] Coins: Now have a duration of 60s (previously 40s).
[*] Experience: Now have a duration of 60s (previously 50s).
[*] Healing Vial: Now have a duration of 60s (previously 30s).
[*] Minerals (Resources): Now have a duration of 60s (previously 40s).
[*] Merchant Items: Now have a duration of 60s (previously 40s).
[/list]

[b]Next Steps:[/b]
I’m actively working to better balance the game based on the valuable feedback I’ve received from the community. My goal is to make the experience more enjoyable and fair for all players.

In parallel, I’m developing a [b]roadmap[/b] for this year that will include exciting new content.

[i]I want to thank all players for their patience and continuous support. Your feedback and engagement are key to improving and evolving this project.

Thank you for being part of this adventure![/i]

notes.title: Minor game update to 1.0.1
notes.content:
Thank you very much to everyone for the feedback. I will continue to tweak and improve the systems as I detect problems or player feedback. 

Here are the changes made:

[b]Progression:[/b]
[list][*] The quality of resources that can be obtained from enemies has been adjusted: now the most valuable resources drop on higher difficulties.[/list]
[b]Passives:[/b]
[list][*] The “Gold Rush” passive has been redesigned, now it will be “More Blueprints in barrels”. This new passive will increase the amount of blueprints you get from random barrel events during raids. [/list][i]Note: this passive greatly unbalanced the progression as it affected the passive system itself, I have opted for a new passive that does not directly impact the progression of the passives but will help improve the submarine upgrade system. Don't worry if you had invested your coins in the passive, as you can reset only that passive if you wish and re-invest the coins where you need them.[/i]

[b]Merchant:[/b]
[list][*] The merchant will no longer offer the “Gold Rush” deal, it will now offer “More blueprints in barrels”.[/list]
[b]Submarines:[/b] 
[list][*] Changed the max level bonus of the “Balanced” submarine to 25% damage (previously it was 40% extra coins).
[*] Changed the maximum level bonus of the “Demolisher” submarine to 25% critical damage (before it was 25% damage).
[/list]

Keep on exterminating sea creatures, captains!
